Theorem
[Trace Theorem] ↗ def:sobolev-space-wkp ↗ thm:global-smooth-approximation-boundary 1. ch5:5.5-thm-1\group Sobolev Traces

Assume $U$ is bounded and $\partial U$ is $C^1$. Then there exists a bounded linear operator \[ T : W^{1,p}(U) \to L^p(\partial U) \] such that

  • $Tu = u|_{\partial U}$ if $u \in W^{1,p}(U) \cap C(\overline{U})$

and

  • \[ \| Tu\| _{L^p(\partial U)} \le C\| u\| _{W^{1,p}(U)}, \]

for each $u \in W^{1,p}(U)$, with the constant $C$ depending only on $p$ and $U$.

Proof

\sketch For smooth functions, integrate the normal derivative across flattened boundary charts and apply Young inequality to obtain the local boundary estimate. Patch finitely many charts, then define the trace by completing smooth approximants in $L^p(\partial U)$.

□
